correctness.rationale: The bound and equalities are reconstructed for all q>=2 via disjoint type-(3), type-(2,1) and type-(1,1,1) shadows, not inferred from finite data. At optimum, every arc is allocated to a pair-square or exactly one centered mixed wedge; an absent pair-square forces an even-degree graph and the local neighbor partition. The converse analyzes all three received multiplicity patterns and proves their collision-freedom under the exact design and nonrepetition hypotheses. Odd-q Steiner leaves follow from each pair having an odd residual triple count and punctured Hanani SQS construction, so the graph must be empty. Small-q boundaries, the q=6 complement packing and its distinct wedge triples were checked from actual verify.py, which returned VERIFY_OK for q=2..8 plus the mixed optimum. No finite search is substituted for the universal proof.

value.rationale: All optimal codebooks at every alphabet size are parameterized exactly, with explicit necessary/sufficient data and unique reconstruction. The q=6 mixed example shows that the standard canonical construction is not exhaustive in general; the Steiner corollary proves precisely when the mixed layer vanishes for four infinite congruence families. These are motivated structural classifications of extremal multiset-deletion codes, not textbook reformulations of their already known size.
